rq: joint identification of raw language equivalence and latent intervention partition
primary_work: Choo, Gouleakis, and Bhattacharyya, Active causal structure learning with advice, ICML 2023
official_code: author-declared code/supplementary material; paper-specific immutable repository not confirmed
decision: NARROWED BEYOND ADVICE-GUIDED ACTIVE CAUSAL STRUCTURE RECOVERY — NOT ADOPTED
reason: Advice-guided active causal graph recovery with worst-case robustness is established prior art, but it assumes a fixed common vertex alphabet shared by the advice graph, intervention actions, and returned orientations. Exact DAG recovery and low intervention cost remain invariant under simultaneous advice/vertex/action/utterance relabeling. More adaptive interaction cannot break a semantic symmetry when the complete query-response-cost oracle is equivariant, so the result does not jointly identify raw-language equivalence, latent target partition, or denotation.
surviving_candidate: After recovering the strongest unlabeled causal structure and target partition available from non-language observations, and treating raw language only as fallible unparsed advice, determine whether a preregistered family of physically indexed active probes has a query-response-cost law whose stabilizer intersects the residual language/target automorphism group only in the permitted trivial equivalence; if so, establish whether this jointly identifies Q, residual P, and denotation d without parser, simulator-label, or target-codebook leakage.
public_baseline_reproduction: not started; primary paper and author-declared code are public, but a paper-specific immutable repository commit was not confirmed. Reproduction would test advice-guided active DAG recovery over fixed indexed variables, not joint language/target identification
